figures.caption: Figure 2: Overview of the RT-RkNN workflow. The input is separated into a user set and a facility set. Users are modeled as rays, while facilities are used to construct occluders based on the invalid sides of pairwise bisectors. All occluders are embedded as layered triangles in a 3D scene indexed by a BVH. During query processing, each user ray is cast perpendicularly to 𝑥,𝑦-plane. A user is reported as an R𝑘NN result if and only if its ray intersects fewer than 𝑘 occluders.
